user.title: Comfort Schedule
user.description: Pick the thermostat to schedule. Comfort Schedule creates a new thermostat entity that wraps it and keeps heat below cool.

data.name: Name
data.deadband: Minimum gap between heat and cool

data_description.name: Leave blank to name it after the thermostat.
data_description.notify_entity: Optional. Warnings also appear under Settings > Repairs.
data_description.deadband: Should be at least the thermostat's own auto-changeover deadband.

error.own_entity: That thermostat is already a Comfort Schedule thermostat. Pick the real one.
error.not_found: That entity isn't available right now.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a Comfort Schedule.

data.deadband: Minimum gap between heat and cool

health.name: HVAC health
health.description: When to warn about runs that don't work or are getting slower.

data.heat_minutes: Warn if heating this long without progress
data.cool_minutes: Warn if cooling this long without progress
data.wrong_way: Warn if the temperature moves the wrong way by
data.trend_drop: Warn when runs get this much slower than they used to

data_description.min_progress: How far the temperature must move toward the set point during a run.
data_description.wrong_way: Checked from 10 minutes into a run, and it has to last more than 10 minutes.
data_description.trend_drop: Compares the last two weeks with the weeks before, in similar outdoor temperatures. 0 turns it off.

heat_cool.name: Heat/Cool
heat_cool.description: For thermostats that only have Heat and Cool.

data.changeover_margin: Heat/Cool: switch once the room is this far past the other set point
data.changeover_minutes: Heat/Cool: minimum time between switching Heat and Cool
data.force_heat_cool_emulation: Heat/Cool: switch Heat and Cool myself even if the thermostat has its own Heat/Cool mode

data_description.changeover_margin: Only used when Comfort Schedule provides Heat/Cool by switching the thermostat between Heat and Cool.
data_description.changeover_minutes: Protects the furnace and AC from rapid back-and-forth switching.
data_description.force_heat_cool_emulation: Normally the thermostat's own Heat/Cool mode is used when it has one.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Use the away set points while nobody is home.

data.away_delay: Wait this long after the last person leaves

data_description.presence_entities: Anyone home (person or tracker home, zone above 0, or a sensor on) counts as home. Unknown counts as home.
data_description.away_heat: Needed when people or trackers are picked.
data_description.away_cool: Needed when people or trackers are picked.

data.filter_hours: Filter reminder after this many hours of runtime

data_description.outdoor_entity: A temperature sensor or a weather entity. Used to compare runtime against the weather and for early start.
data_description.filter_hours: Heating plus cooling hours. 0 turns it off. Reset with the Filter changed button.
data_description.heat_cost: For the cost estimate on the runtime card. Roughly the furnace's gas use per hour times your rate.
data_description.cool_cost: Roughly the AC's kW times your electricity rate.

data.early_start_max: Early start: begin up to this long before a block
data.suggestions: Suggest schedule changes from repeated manual changes

data_description.early_start_max: Learns how fast the room heats or cools and starts the next block early enough to be there on time. 0 turns it off.
data_description.suggestions: Suggestions show on the schedule card; nothing changes until you apply one.

thermostats.name: More thermostats
thermostats.description: Run other thermostats on this schedule.

data_description.follower_entities: They get the same set points and mode. Health and runtime are tracked on the main thermostat only.

data_description.notify_entity: Optional. Warnings also appear under Settings > Repairs.

error.away_setpoints: Set both away set points to use presence.

hvac_problem.title: {title}
hvac_problem.description:
{message}

This clears on its own once a heating or cooling run moves the temperature again.

filter_due.title: {name}: time to check the filter
filter_due.description: The system has run {hours} hours since the filter was last changed. Press the Filter changed button (or call comfort_schedule.filter_changed) once it's done.

hvac_slowdown.title: {name}: {kind} is getting slower
hvac_slowdown.description:
Over the last two weeks, {kind} moved the room {recent} an hour, against {baseline} an hour before in similar weather ({drop}% slower).

A dirty filter, blocked vents or a system that needs service are the usual causes. This clears on its own once runs speed up again.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the weekly schedule. Seven days, Monday first; each day is a list of periods with start (minutes after midnight), heat, cool and label, plus optional mode (off, heat, cool, heat_cool) and fan (one of the thermostat's fan modes) to apply when the period starts. Leave mode or fan out (or null) to keep whatever is set at the time.

label_colors.name: Label colors
label_colors.description: Optional colors for block labels, as #RRGGBB. Leave out to keep the current colors.

set_hold.name: Set hold
set_hold.description: Overrides the schedule with fixed set points for a while.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Heat set point. Leave out to keep the current one.

cool.name: Cool
cool.description: Cool set point. Leave out to keep the current one.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the hold lasts. Leave out to use the default from the options.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Ends any hold and turns the schedule back on.

pause_schedule.name: Pause schedule
pause_schedule.description: Stops following the schedule. The current set points stay until you change them.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Holds the given set points from start to end, then goes back to the schedule. Replaces any earlier vacation.

start.name: Start
start.description: When it starts. Leave out to start now.

end.name: End
end.description: When the schedule takes over again.

cancel_vacation.name: Cancel vacation
cancel_vacation.description: Removes the vacation, whether it has started or not.

filter_changed.name: Filter changed
filter_changed.description: Starts the filter reminder's runtime count over.

apply_suggestion.name: Apply suggestion
apply_suggestion.description: Applies one of the schedule suggestions to the schedule.

id.name: Suggestion
id.description: The suggestion's id, from the thermostat's suggestions attribute.

dismiss_suggestion.name: Dismiss suggestion
dismiss_suggestion.description: Hides a schedule suggestion for good.

id.name: Suggestion
id.description: The suggestion's id, from the thermostat's suggestions attribute.
